Diablo 4 Warlock Build (Shadow Summoner) Terror Swarm Build Lord of Hatred Guide
In this Diablo 4 build guide, I'm going to be showing you my Shadow Summoner build. This is an endgame Warlock build for Diablo 4 that focuses on using abyss demonology skills to deal massive burst damage, and should just wipe out packs of enemies in a couple of casts very very quickly, through the clever use of multiple ultimates.
